run_inplace_unary_on_maskedtensor: run inplace unary operations like abs_ or neg_ on MaskedTensor objects in-place
test_sparse_coo_unary_support: test unary operations on MaskedTensor with sparse_coo layout tensors
test_sparse_csr_unary_support: test unary operations on MaskedTensor with sparse_csr layout tensors
check_native_unary_function: check whether a torch ops.aten function is registered as a supported native unary operation
